subject: BrightBridge Q2 check-in: health signals & exec attention list
summary: Prep thread for BrightBridge Q2 check-in. Internal team triages renewal risk signals, finalizes an exec attention list, and schedules a pre-QBR alignment call with the customer. Key asks: validate top three health regressions, confirm procurement timeline, and prepare exec-level slides for Friday's review.
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBridge Q2 check-in: health signals & exec attention list

Team —

Putting this thread together to prime leadership ahead of BrightBridge's Q2 check-in (QBR scheduled for 2027-05-07). Attached is the draft risk register I compiled from our health signals workbook. High-level highlights:

- Usage plateau: API calls down ~18% month-over-month in one strategic product line (see tab "UsageSignals").
- Latency spikes: 95th percentile spikes during peak ET hours, impacting two pilot routes.
- Billing discrepancy: customer flagged an unexpected invoice line; procurement is involved.

Immediate asks (please respond by EOD Tuesday):
1) Marissa — confirm whether CS has recent case notes that point to feature adoption blockers.
2) Markus — can infra confirm if the latency pattern aligns with the rollout we did on 2027-04-20?
3) Rishi — draft a one‑slide exec attention note (2 bullets max) summarizing risk and recommended remediation path.

Attachment: BrightBridge_Q2_Health_Signals.xlsx (xlsx)

I'll stitch together a short "primers" deck for execs once we have your inputs. We should also try to get a 30-minute alignment call with the customer before the QBR — Marissa, can you reach out to Chris?

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Dalton <chris@brightbridgehealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBridge Q2 check-in: health signals & exec attention list

Hi Chris / Samantha —

Quick note to see if you have 30 minutes this week for a pre-QBR alignment. We want to surface a couple of items in advance so the QBR can focus on outcomes and next steps, not troubleshooting. Proposed slots:
- Tue 2027-05-03 10:00-10:30 PT
- Tue 2027-05-03 15:00-15:30 PT

Agenda (5 min each):
- Top health signals we observed (usage drop / latency spikes)
- Any open procurement timing or billing items
- Agree on success criteria for renewal conversation

Marissa Cole
Strategic Account Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

Marissa / Lauren —

Thanks for the heads-up. Tue afternoon (15:00 PT) works for us. A couple of prep notes from our side:

- We did an internal spike related to model tuning on 2027-04-21 that may explain some of the latency — engineering will bring context.
- Procurement needs clarity on the invoicing line; copied them here. We are tracking a delay in PO issuance but expect to resolve by the end of next week.

Please send any pre-read materials and the one-slide exec note so our VP can scan before the call.

chris@brightbridgehealth.com

Folks —

Attached is a concise exec primer (BB_QBR_exec_primers_v1.pptx). I kept it to two slides per risk area: one slide for the signal/evidence and one for the recommended mitigation + ask. Top-of-deck notes:

- Priority #1: Restore stable 95th pct latency for pilot routes. Recommendation: revert last deploy to prior kernel + temporary route-level cache config. Estimated effort: 6-10 engineer-hours; risk reduction high.
- Priority #2: Usage reactivation plan for the flagged product team — propose a targeted feature adoption campaign + product workshop next week.
- Priority #3: Invoice reconciliation — ask procurement to confirm PO timing; consider a one-time credit if billing timing impacts renewal negotiation.

Requests for execs: please review the deck and: 
- Confirm approval to proceed with the rollback plan (Markus)
- Approve a capped credit up to $25k if procurement timing materially delays renewal (Lauren / Evelyn)
- Sign off on asking product to run a 60-minute adoption workshop with BrightBridge next week (Marissa)

I'll hold a 30-minute dry run Thurs 2027-05-06 09:00 PT for any execs who want to walk through slides.

Attachment: BB_QBR_exec_primers_v1.pptx (pptx)

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Technical Solutions
Redwood Inference
